q: In AEC software, what does the acronym BIM stand for?
explain: The US National BIM Standard defines Building Information Modeling as generating and using a shared digital representation of a built environment asset to support design, construction and operation.

sources.title: NBIMS-US V4 - Terms and Definitions - National Institute of Building Sciences
sources.quote: Building Information Modeling Generating and using a shared digital representation of a built environment asset to facilitate design, construction, and operation processes to form a reliable basis for decisions.

sources.title: Defining BIM - BIM Planning - Penn State
sources.quote: BIM is the acronym of "Building Information Modeling," reflecting and emphasizing the process aspects, and not of "Building Information Model."

q: Under which ISO standard number is the open BIM data standard Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) published?
explain: IFC is an open, vendor-neutral standard maintained by buildingSMART International and published as ISO 16739; the latest version, IFC 4.3, is ISO 16739-1:2024.

sources.title: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) - buildingSMART International
sources.quote: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) are a set of standardized, digital descriptions of the built asset industry. It is an open, global standard published under a Creative Commons license, and as ISO 16739.

sources.title: ISO 16739-1:2024 - Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) for data sharing in the construction and facility management industries
sources.quote: This document represents an open international standard for information used in Building Information Modeling (BIM) that is exchanged and shared among software applications used by the various participants in the construction or facility management industry sector.

q: What term describes a computer model of a particular physical system, such as a machine or building, used to predict and monitor that system's behavior?
explain: NIST describes a digital twin as a particular type of computer model of a physical system; digital twins primarily function to make predictions or act as a status indicator for the modeled system.

sources.title: Digital twins | NIST
sources.quote: A digital twin is a particular type of computer model of a physical system, such as a machine or building, that has the potential for high accuracy, precision, and flexibility to model various aspects of a system. ... Digital twins primarily function to make predictions or as a status indicator for a system that is being modeled.

sources.title: Digital Twin (official) - GOV.UK
sources.quote: A digital twin is a digital representation of a real-world entity, environment or process that allows the inclusion of a 2-way communication ... flow into and out of the real world
